name: B10-0455/2025 (ECR) – Situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text:
The European Parliament says Lukashenka is not Belarus's legitimate president and that Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya won the 2020 election. It calls for all political prisoners to be freed, for sanctions to stay or grow, and for the EU to back Belarusian opposition groups, media, culture and language. It also accuses Lukashenka of helping Russia's war on Ukraine and of using migrants to pressure neighbouring EU countries.

- The EU is urged to keep and widen sanctions and to fund Belarusian media and culture.
- Political prisoners, exiled opposition groups and Belarusian journalists are the focus.
- The Parliament asks the EU to act; it cannot change policy by itself.
